followed_sources_checked.notes: Used for BEHAVIOR-1K, SceneFun3D, PhysDreamer, WorldScore-adjacent Stanford lines.
Used for Infinigen Indoors and procedural generation branch.
Used for Holodeck embodied environment generation.
Used for SAGE, GR00T N1, SpaceTools, and physical AI follow-up search.
Used for Octo/OpenVLA robot policy baselines.
Used for pi0 high-quality robot demo evidence.
Used for SceneSmith simulation-ready indoor scene generation.
Used for HY-World 2.0 open world generation line.

candidates.title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes
candidates.why_candidate: Defines reusable fields Object, Part, Affordance, FunctionalElement, TaskLanguage, MotionParameter for our typed interactive-world representation.

candidates.title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: Directly informs Task, StatePredicate, GoalCondition, SceneObject, PhysicalProperty, and validation protocol design.

candidates.title: PhysX-Omni: Unified Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Generation for Rigid, Deformable, and Articulated Objects
candidates.why_candidate: Strong candidate for PhysicalProperty, Material, DeformableState, KinematicJoint, and simulator export fields.

candidates.title: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

candidates.title: Feature Splatting: Language-Driven Physics-Based Scene Synthesis and Editing
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

candidates.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for InteractionConstraint, Reachability, Collision, Articulation, and GeneratedScene validity metrics.

candidates.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
candidates.why_candidate: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

candidates.title: Infinigen Indoors: Photorealistic Indoor Scenes using Procedural Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

candidates.title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
candidates.why_candidate: Directly motivates TaskGenerator, SceneGenerator, SupervisionGenerator, PolicyLearner, and validation-loop abstractions.

candidates.title: SpatialVLA: Exploring Spatial Representations for Visual-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for Scene.spatial_graph, Ego3DEncoding, SpatialActionToken, and spatial instruction validation.

candidates.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for Policy, Observation, ActionDistribution, GoalImageCondition, and embodiment adaptation.

candidates.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
candidates.why_candidate: Baseline for VLA policy execution, generated-task transfer, action-token interface, and finetuning experiments.

candidates.title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
candidates.why_candidate: Sets a high demo-quality target for robot execution, deformable manipulation, long-horizon interaction, and continuous action generation.

candidates.title: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
candidates.why_candidate: Useful for benchmark packaging, generated-task evaluation, policy baselines, and trajectory/data schema design.

candidates.title: OpenEQA: Embodied Question Answering in the Era of Foundation Models
candidates.why_candidate: downstream benchmark for testing whether generated interactive environments preserve object identity, spatial relations, and semantic affordances

candidates.title: PhysX-Anything: Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Assets from Single Image
candidates.why_candidate: Strong object-level source for PhysicalProperty, KinematicJoint, AssetToSimulator, and contact-rich policy-learning validation.

candidates.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
candidates.why_candidate: Relevant to SceneTree, SupportRelation, PhysicalViolation, and simulator-ready reconstruction validators.

candidates.title: REST3D: Reconstructing Physically Stable 3D Scenes from a Single Image
candidates.why_candidate: Provides a useful template for SceneTree, SupportGraph, StabilityCheck, and PhysicsRefinement stages.

candidates.title: TriSplat: Simulation-Ready Feed-Forward 3D Scene Reconstruction
candidates.why_candidate: Useful representation reference for MeshScene, CollisionSurface, and feed-forward sim-ready reconstruction.

candidates.title: Steerable Scene Generation
candidates.why_candidate: strong baseline for task-constrained scene generation

candidates.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI
candidates.why_candidate: closest PCG baseline; it can use a typed interaction representation as I/O and evaluator

candidates.title: EmbodiedGen: Towards a Generative 3D World Engine for Embodied Intelligence
candidates.why_candidate: generation engine that can consume or be evaluated by a typed interactive-world representation

candidates.title: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
candidates.why_candidate: Top PCG baseline for PromptToScene, CriticLoop, ObjectPopulation, PhysicalProperty, and policy evaluation.

candidates.title: SceneFoundry: Generating Interactive Infinite 3D Worlds
candidates.why_candidate: Relevant PCG line for LayoutConstraint, ArticulationConstraint, WalkableSpace, and infinite-world expansion.

candidates.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
candidates.why_candidate: Strong open-source world-generation baseline for WorldRepresentation, TrajectoryPlan, 3DGSScene, MeshExport, and engine integration.

candidates.title: SpatialBot: Precise Spatial Understanding with Vision Language Models
candidates.why_candidate: supports grounding spatial relations from observations

candidates.title: HiSpatial: Taming Hierarchical 3D Spatial Understanding in Vision-Language Models
candidates.why_candidate: useful for spatial relation completion and validation

candidates.title: SpaceTools: Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning via Double Interactive RL
candidates.why_candidate: prototype for target-task validators that invoke measurement/simulation tools

candidates.title: Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models in Ego-Centric Multi-View Scenes
candidates.why_candidate: supports Scene coordinate-frame and relation grounding

candidates.title: Seeing Across Views / MV-RoboBench
candidates.why_candidate: important benchmark for observation-to-scene-graph parsing

candidates.title: DepthVLA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Models with Depth-Aware Spatial Reasoning
candidates.why_candidate: supports depth-based scene grounding and precise spatial action

candidates.title: ST-VLA: Enabling 4D-Aware Spatiotemporal Understanding for General Robot Manipulation
candidates.why_candidate: points to temporal/deformable state and trajectory grounding

candidates.title: SpatialStack: Layered Geometry-Language Fusion for 3D VLM Spatial Reasoning
candidates.why_candidate: Good spatial encoder/validator reference for local geometry, global context, and relation checking in generated worlds.

candidates.title: VLA-R1: Enhancing Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: bridges target-task predicates and action selection

candidates.title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI
candidates.why_candidate: aligns directly with target-task StateTransition and ValidationReport

candidates.title: Physically Viable World Models
candidates.why_candidate: supports the target representation as a query-conditioned physical interface

candidates.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
candidates.why_candidate: Important VLA baseline for humanoid embodiments and synthetic-data-to-policy evaluation.

candidates.title: Green-VLA: Staged Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Robots
candidates.why_candidate: Useful systems reference for staged VLA training and safety-aware execution.

candidates.title: XR-1: Towards Versatile Vision-Language-Action Models via Learning Unified Vision-Motion Representations
candidates.why_candidate: Strong VLA reference for cross-embodiment action representation and real rollout quality.

candidates.title: TwinVLA: Data-Efficient Bimanual Manipulation with Twin Single-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
candidates.why_candidate: Good baseline for bimanual task generation and policy-evaluation suites.

candidates.title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation
candidates.why_candidate: Relevant to world-action interfaces because it predicts future visual outcomes and actions jointly.

candidates.title: EWMBench: Evaluating Embodied World Models
candidates.why_candidate: evaluation philosophy for interactive embodied generation benchmark

candidates.title: WorldScore: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for World Generation
candidates.why_candidate: baseline for interactive embodied generation benchmark metrics

candidates.title: WorldArena: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Perception and Functional Utility of Embodied World Models
candidates.why_candidate: Important evaluation target for our interactive embodied world generator and world-model branches.

candidates.title: World-in-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World
candidates.why_candidate: Provides a harness template for action-conditioned rollout evaluation and closed-loop generated-world testing.

candidates.title: Ctrl-World
candidates.why_candidate: Useful benchmark design for world-action model validators and imagined rollout tests.
